verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a durable workflow orchestration engine, so workflow versioning during deploys is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents workflow versioning, pinning in-flight runs to their starting code version, or determinism safeguards across deploys. The `hatchet worker dev` auto-reload is a local development convenience, and the ahead-of-time DAG declaration is a different design trait; neither counts as versioning support.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I deploy new workflow code while in-flight runs finish on the version they started with — versioning without breaking determinism
